cp011DistinctLabelledUnrestricted.rule: Each distinct object independently chooses exactly one labelled receiver.

cp011DistinctLabelledAllNonEmpty.rule: Every labelled receiver must receive at least one distinct object.

cp011DistinctLabelledExactlyKUsed.rule: Exactly the stated number of labelled receivers are non-empty.

cp011DistinctLabelledAtLeastOneEmpty.rule: At least one labelled receiver remains unused.

cp011DistinctLabelledExactOccupancies.rule: Each named receiver has its stated exact occupancy.

cp011DistinctSpecifiedBoxExact.rule: The specified receiver has exact occupancy; all other labelled receivers are unrestricted.

cp011DistinctSpecifiedBoxExactOthersNonE.rule: The specified receiver has exact occupancy and every other receiver is non-empty.

cp011DistinctIdenticalExactlyK.rule: Exactly the stated number of indistinguishable non-empty receivers are used.

cp011DistinctIdenticalAtMostK.rule: Any positive number up to the stated maximum of indistinguishable receivers may be used.

cp011DistinctIdenticalAnyNonEmptyCount.rule: The distinct objects may be partitioned into any positive number of unnamed non-empty groups.
